title: CubePath Kubernetes
description: Clusters, control plane, node pools, nodes and node servers of CubePath Managed Kubernetes, from cubepath-k8s-exporter.

panels.title: Clusters monitored
panels.description: Clusters the CubePath monitoring collector polled in the last 10 minutes.

panels.title: Clusters up
panels.description: Clusters whose API server answered the latest poll.

panels.title: Clusters ready
panels.description: Clusters where every readyz check passed.

panels.title: Nodes ready
panels.description: Nodes whose Ready condition is true.

panels.title: API server latency
panels.description: Latency of the latest successful poll by the CubePath monitoring collector.

panels.title: Certificate days left
panels.description: Days until the API server certificate and the monitoring client certificate expire.

panels.title: Clusters
panels.description: Version, status, location and HA flag from the CubePath inventory (empty when the inventory is unavailable).

panels.title: Cluster up and ready
panels.description: 1 is healthy.

panels.title: Failed readyz checks
panels.description: Series exist only while a check fails or the latest poll failed.

panels.title: Component ready replicas
panels.description: Platform components in kube-system: cilium, api_proxy, konnectivity, coredns, autoscaler.

panels.title: Components below desired
panels.description: Desired minus ready replicas.

panels.title: Seconds since last poll
panels.description: Age of the latest poll by the CubePath monitoring collector (it polls every 60 seconds).

panels.title: Nodes per pool (current, desired, min, max)
panels.description: Current counts pool members not removed. Pool data needs the CubePath inventory; it is absent when the inventory is unavailable.

panels.title: Pools below desired
panels.description: Desired minus current. Above zero means nodes are missing.

panels.title: Pools
panels.description: Plan, autoscaling flag and nominal plan size of each pool.

panels.title: Node ready
panels.description: 1 when the Ready condition is true.

panels.title: Pressure conditions
panels.description: Series shown only while memory, disk or PID pressure is true.

panels.title: Cordoned nodes
panels.description: 1 when the node is cordoned.

panels.title: CPU: usage vs allocatable
panels.description: Cores. Usage comes from metrics-server (sampled every 5 minutes) and is absent without it.

panels.title: Usage as share of allocatable CPU
Usage as share of allocatable memory
Nodes
panels.description: Pool, kubelet version, server id, allocatable pods and time since the last Ready transition.

panels.title: CPU usage
panels.description: Measured from outside the guest by the CubePath monitoring collector.

panels.title: Network public
panels.description: First network interface of the server.

panels.title: Network private
panels.description: Private network interface of the server.

panels.title: Network total (when per-NIC data is missing)
panels.description: Sum over all interfaces, exposed only when the per-NIC series have no fresh point.

panels.title: Seconds since newest server sample
panels.description: Server series have a 30 second step; points older than 5 minutes are dropped.

panels.title: Truncated
panels.description: 1 when the snapshot was cut to 100 clusters or 1000 nodes.

panels.title: Data families available
panels.description: clusters, pools and node_vm. A 0 means the token cannot read it or the API failed.
